title: Admin and Tenant auth-surface startup recovery

phases.objective: Restore one consistent JWT secret contract before any Admin or Tenant route module loads, and keep production liveness responsive while dependencies are degraded.

e2e_journeys.actor: Hostinger production runtime, Admin caller, and Tenant caller
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The repository-root Hostinger entrypoint starts with BACKEND_API_KEY and without a separately configured JWT_SECRET
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The runtime derives and installs a backend-bound JWT secret before route imports, /health remains bounded, and Admin plus Tenant auth surfaces return governed authentication responses instead of verifier-unavailable 503 responses.
steps: Resolve JWT_SECRET, USER_JWT_SECRET, or AUTH_JWT_SECRET in canonical precedence.
When no dedicated JWT secret exists, derive a deterministic non-exported JWT secret from BACKEND_API_KEY before importing the application.
Start the application through the repository-root entrypoint for both root and nested npm start commands.
Verify invalid Bearer tokens are rejected without user_jwt_verifier_unavailable.
Bound Redis, queue, and database health probes so dependency stalls do not block liveness.
assertions: The canonical JWT secret is populated before any route module reads process.env.JWT_SECRET.
No secret value is logged or returned.
Admin and Tenant route probes are mounted and return 401 or 403 rather than 404, 500, or 503.
The health endpoint returns HTTP 200 with healthy or degraded dependency status within its bounded timeout.
Database health connections are released in a finally block.
No SQL, migration, provider call, credential read, external send, deployment command, protected-branch direct update, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: Read back auth.mad4b.com health, deployment SHA, Admin catalog, and Tenant catalog after Production promotion.
Exercise explicit JWT secret aliases, BACKEND_API_KEY rotation, dependency timeouts, invalid tokens, and missing-secret fail-closed startup.
Run read-only Admin and Tenant canaries against the exact deployed Production SHA.
Verify Hostinger fresh build and exact-SHA parity without applying migrations.
